headline: Humanoid robots smash Usain Bolt's 100-meter record
summary: Chinese humanoid robots have shattered Usain Bolt's 100-meter record. Tiangong Ultra ran 9.39 seconds, beating Bolt's 9.58-second sprint. The historic feat occurred at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing.

headline: GTA VI: all the news on Rockstar's next entry in the Grand Theft Auto series
summary: GTA VI has faced multiple delays, now targeting a late 2026 release. Rockstar Games pushed the predicted launch twice since GTA V's debut over a decade ago. Fans eagerly await updates on the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto sequel.

headline: We're All Going to the World's Fair is an intimate coming-of-age horror film
summary: Jane Schoenbrun's debut horror film, "We're All Going to the World's Fair," is revisited. The movie is hailed as an intimate coming-of-age horror story. It first captivated audiences at the Sundance festival in 2021.

headline: Grand Theft Auto VI exists in its own universe
summary: A new column explores how Grand Theft Auto VI establishes its own unique universe. The "Stepback" newsletter delves into GTA VI and the gaming industry's landscape. Andrew Webster provides insights on the game's distinct world-building.

headline: Peggy Carter Getting 'Frisbeed to Death' in Doctor Strange Was 'A Complete Disservice,' Hayley Atwell Says
summary: Hayley Atwell slams Peggy Carter's "Frisbeed to Death" scene in Doctor Strange 2. She labeled the character's multiverse demise a "complete disservice." Atwell expressed strong dissatisfaction with the controversial moment.

headline: Lanterns Showrunner on Episode 2's Big Ending: 'When and Where to Use the Ring Is the Whole Ballgame'
summary: Lanterns showrunner Chris Mundy discusses Episode 2's crucial ending. Mundy highlights the strategic importance of using the Green Lantern ring effectively. The episode emphasizes the "when and where" of wielding immense power.

headline: Lanterns Season 1, Episode 2 Review & Recap
summary: Lanterns Season 1, Episode 2 continues to impress critics and viewers. The episode showcases strong performances from Kyle Chandler as Hal. Aaron Pierre's John also shines, proving their entertaining chemistry.

headline: The Best Deals Today: LEGO Animal Crossing, Nintendo Switch 2, Nioh 3, and More
summary: Discover today's top deals on popular gaming items and tech. Find offers on LEGO Animal Crossing sets and other exciting products. Includes updates on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nioh 3 news.

headline: Social media firms should remove dangerous driving videos, minister says
summary: Defence minister Luke Pollard demands social media firms remove dangerous driving videos. He states there's "no place" for trends like driving against traffic. The minister calls for stricter content moderation to curb harmful online acts.

headline: Divorce, smartphones and control - BBC sees how Taliban run Afghanistan
summary: The BBC reports on the Taliban's rule in Afghanistan five years post-return. The story examines how the group is reshaping the country with strict controls. Divorce laws and smartphone usage under Taliban governance are explored.

headline: Tesla recalls nearly three million cars in China over hidden door handles
summary: Tesla recalls nearly three million cars in China due to hidden door handle issues. The large-scale recall impacts multiple Tesla models in the region. Chinese automakers XPeng, Xiaomi, and Geely are also affected by similar recalls.

headline: 'It's not Alton Towers' - rows break out over queuing at Wales' highest mountain
summary: Rows erupt over queuing at Yr Wyddfa, Wales' highest mountain. Visitors are clashing over people skipping lines to reach the summit. The dispute highlights tensions between respectful waiting and bypassing queues.
